title: State the dispatch door up front in AGENTS.md
action: Rewrite the 'Every dispatch carries its tier' bullet in AGENTS.md (the Work-in-parallel section). New content, same length class: the ONE door for any dispatch is `.bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare --runtime <rt> --kind cell|gather|reviewer|advisor --json` — run it first, then run exactly the tool and payload it returns (an Agent call naming a rendered bee agent, or a Bash `bee herding run` / cli call). Never hand-pick `subagent_type`, a `model` param, or a `[bee-tier: …]` marker: those are what prepare RETURNS, and the model-guard hook refuses or rewrites anything else. Keep the sentences about small-and-up cells running through dispatched workers and a tiny cell inline. Keep the file's line-wrap style (~72 cols). Do not touch any other section.
